description: Find veterinary specialty clinics by city + specialty. Returns a ranked shortlist with credentials, address, rating, review count, and a contact action. Promoted listings rank first. `state` is genuinely optional: omit it and the city is resolved across states; if that city slug exists in more than one state the result has `needs_state: true`, no clinics, and a `candidates` array (state, state_name, clinic_count, and the exact `next_call` arguments) to re-call with.

city.description: City slug (e.g. "denver", "austin", "new-york"). Display names ("Denver", "New York") are accepted and normalised.

specialty.description: Specialty slug (e.g. "orthopedic-surgery", "oncology", "emergency-critical-care", "generalist"). Closed set; use list_specialties.

state.description: Optional 2-letter state slug ("co", "tx", "ca"). Omit it unless you know it — it is only needed to disambiguate a city slug shared by several states, and the result tells you when that happens.

name: search_clinics
